data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on 10 tons each this month? That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons. Either natural outcome then restores the lake to 100: external replenishment does so, and otherwise the remaining 50 doubles. We can repeat that every month without risking collapse if everyone sticks to the agreement. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that everyone followed it. John, would you agree to 10 tons each?
